name: University College Cork
summary: Cork's university, from Arts and Commerce to Food Science and Medicine; you apply through CAO with your IB results and no personal statement.

ib.text: Six subjects with English; a third language for most Arts, Law, Commerce, Medicine and Health degrees; Maths for Commerce and sciences. Strictest: Medicine HL 5 in Chemistry and in Physics or Biology, plus HPAT.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Five years rooted in anatomy, physiology and biochemistry, with small-group, patient-centred teaching in listening, history-taking and clinical examination from the start, and a research project for every student in the final year.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in Chemistry and in Physics or Biology; SL 4 in English, Maths and another language. HPAT-Ireland is required in your year of entry.
programmes.selectionNote: HPAT-Ireland counts for up to 150 CAO points from 2027, and points above 550 are no longer moderated. Sit the test in the year you enter.

flagshipSource.title: UCC Medicine: small-group, patient-centred teaching, and a research project for every student in final year

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: A common first year in maths, physics, chemistry and the four engineering branches, then your pathway: Civil, Structural and Environmental; Electrical and Electronic; Energy; or Process and Chemical. A five-year ME is optional.
programmes.ib: HL Maths 5, a lab science or technology subject at SL 4 and one more HL 5 subject, plus SL 4 in English and another language.

needs.note: A lab science or technology subject

programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points: IB totals are converted with the CAO table, plus 25 points for HL Maths 4 or better. You are guaranteed one of your top two pathways after year 1.

flagshipSource.title: UCC Engineering: Engineers Ireland and Washington Accord recognition, with paid work placements

programmes.name: Commerce
programmes.about: Business economics, law, management, marketing, information systems and statistics, with five majors to choose from in year 4 and a six-month internship or a semester abroad in year 3.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects, and SL 4 in English, Maths and another language.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points: your IB total is converted with the CAO table. Two subjects must be at HL 5 or better.

flagshipSource.title: UCC Commerce: five majors in year 4, internships for up to 170 students a year

faculties.name: College of Arts, Celtic Studies and Social Sciences
faculties.line: 2026 Round 1 points ran from 300 (Arts) to 543 (Applied Psychology); most Arts subjects add a third language.

faculties.name: College of Business and Law
faculties.line: Commerce asks HL 5 in two subjects plus English, Maths and another language; 2026 points ran from 445 to 577.

faculties.name: College of Science, Engineering and Food Science
faculties.line: Engineering needs HL Maths 5; 2026 Round 1 points ran from 384 to 589.

faculties.name: College of Medicine and Health
faculties.line: Medicine needs HL 5 in Chemistry and in Physics or Biology, plus HPAT; 2026 points ran from 387 to 735.

notes: Irish is part of UCC's entry rule, but you are exempt automatically if you were born and fully educated outside the Republic of Ireland.
Engineering (CK600) needs H4 in Maths, which is IB HL Maths 5 on CAO's comparison table.
From 2027 Medicine (CK701) counts HPAT for at most 150 points, down from 300, and no longer moderates school scores above 550.
